inspections.enforcement: admitForDispatch rejects tasks missing passport or failing BorderGuard check with DISPATCH_BLOCKED_BORDER_GUARD.
Missing or forged passport signature results in MISSING_SIGNATURE and allowed=false.
Worker claims of status=DONE are stripped of global completion authority and admitted=false.
Envelopes with exit_code != 0, missing artifacts, or checksum mismatch are rejected.
EXECUTION_UNCERTAIN states strictly block redispatch and retry (SUPERVISOR_DECISION.BLOCK_EXECUTION_UNCERTAIN).
Uncoordinated fallback tasks with equivalent work signatures are blocked by active leases.
Requires (PID, START_TIME, TASK_TOKEN). Recycled PIDs or UNKNOWN identities return can_terminate=false.
NTFS case-folded normalization blocks parent when child locked, and blocks child when parent locked.
